claim: Standard behavioral cloning (BC) can provably fail to cover the demonstrator's action distribution, which is a necessary condition for effective RL finetuning in low-data-density regions.
stance_target: BC pretraining creates suboptimal RL finetuning initializations
scope_conditions: General robotic policy pretraining; proven via formal analysis
quoted_support: Standard behavioral cloning (Bc)—which trains a policy to directly match the actions played by the demonstrator—can fail to ensure coverage over the demonstrator's actions, a minimal condition necessary for effective RL finetuning.
numbers: 2,000,000 total gradient steps (RL finetuning on Robomimic)

claim: PostBC trains a diffusion-model policy to fit the posterior distribution of demonstrator behavior, achieving demonstrator action coverage while incurring no pretrained performance penalty vs standard BC.
stance_target: Posterior BC pretraining enables more efficient RL finetuning than standard BC
scope_conditions: Manipulation tasks (Robomimic Lift/Can/Square, Libero); diffusion-model policy parameterization
quoted_support: PostBC does cover the demonstrator's distribution, incurs no suboptimality in the performance of the pretrained policy as compared to the standard Bc policy, and achieves a near-optimal sampling cost out of all policy estimators which have pretrained performance no worse than the Bc policy's.

claim: This paper addresses manipulation tasks exclusively (Robomimic, Libero) and provides no locomotion-specific training budgets; its relevance to locomotion is limited to the general principle that pretraining quality affects RL finetuning sample efficiency.
stance_target: Applicability of PostBC findings to locomotion training budgets
scope_conditions: Robotic manipulation; small dataset regime (5-300 demonstrations); diffusion policy architecture
quoted_support: We demonstrate experimentally that PostBc pretraining can lead to significant performance gains in terms of the efficiency and effectiveness of RL finetuning, as compared to running RL finetuning on a policy pretrained with standard Bc.
